responses.change: Specified git-based deletion set computation comparing candidate files (tracked+untracked files via git ls-files plus configured includeIgnored files) against target checkpoint files (git ls-files run under GIT_INDEX_FILE env var), explicitly excluding .git/ and unconfigured ignored paths. Added explicit test cases under tasks T008 for checkpoint-absent file deletion, .git/ safety, and unconfigured ignored file safety.

Explicitly documented the crash-window orphaned ref occurrence under Integrity and Consistency Invariants in data-model.md as a known local single-operator limitation (with reconciliation/recovery deferred to Feature 010 / M2).
